config._rho_note: rho per league = argmin exact-score NLL (fit_rho.py), walk-forward 2025/26-2026/27, lineup-adjusted λ; default = pooled optimum.
config._team_note: 2026-10-31: per-league tuning of xg_w/fit/promo_shift (tune_team.py, 384-combo grid) was REJECTED: tuned on 2025/26 it lost on 2026/27 holdout (pooled log-lik -6.3, RPS 0.2007 vs 0.1991). Shared values rank 6/384 pooled, within 0.9 log-lik of best. Re-check when more seasons are available.
config._lineup_note: 2026-10-31: lineup effect split into injuries (beta_inj: available XI / habitual XI, FotMob pre-match unavailable lists) and lineup surprises (beta_rot: actual XI / available XI), both centred per league (fit_lineup.py). With 2160 matches of real FotMob injury lists the pooled optimum is 0 / 0 (crit 3.3574 vs 3.3576 at rot 0.25; RPS best at 0) and the 2025/26->2026/27 holdout also picks 0 / 0. With npxG+xA player ratings, lineup information does not improve prices. Traders can still set betas in the UI.
config._mkt_note: Rating target = closing-market λ of past matches (football-data 1X2 + O/U 2.5) where available, else goals/xG blend; the market of the match being priced is never used. fit_mkt_ratings.py, pooled 5 leagues: m chosen 1.0 on 2025-26; holdout 2026-27 RPS 0.19905 -> 0.19517 (pre-match market 0.19486).
config._fit_note: With mkt_w=1 (tune_mkt.py, pooled 5 leagues). Rounds 1-10: ridge 1.0 (was 2.5) — better on 2025-26 rounds 1-10 and on the 2026-27 holdout (RPS 0.19437 -> 0.19388). Rounds 11+: fit_late, short memory — 2025-26 rounds 11+ RPS 0.20228 -> 0.20060, chosen in-sample; re-check on 2026-27 rounds 11+ once ~10 such rounds are played.

data_note: Rezultati, xG i postave (Understat) do 30.10.2026, 100 odigranih mečeva. Povrede i postave: FotMob. Postave osvežene 31.10. u 18:55 UTC.
